d: Bihar men Nitish Setu ke udghatan aur namakran ko lekar siyasi bayanbaji jari hai. neta pratipaksh Tejashwi Yadav ke savalon aur tippaniyon par JDU ne palatvar kiya hai. JDU ki or se kaha gaya ki tejasvi yadav ki smaran shakti kam hai. pul ke nirman, shilanyas aur vikas karyon ke shrey ko lekar satta paksh aur vipaksh aamne-samne hain. aakhir nitish setu par JDU ne tejasvi ko kya javab diya? dekhie puri khabra.
